# Mthobisi Nxumalo — Software Engineering Portfolio

> Official portfolio for Mthobisi Nxumalo, a Durban-based Software Engineer and Full Stack Developer who designs, builds, deploys, and supports production web, mobile, desktop, data, and cloud systems.

This portfolio is the authoritative overview of Mthobisi's professional experience, selected engineering work, technical capabilities, and contact channels. The detailed Markdown overview is the preferred compact source for agents. The CV is the authoritative employment and education record.
